title: Version Session and core operational DTOs
description: Define and version SessionDto, CaseSummaryDto, CaseDetailDto, ConversationDto, AuditEventDto.
exit_criteria: Schemas reviewed and committed under src/services/api with version notes.

title: Normalize operational error envelope
description: Standardize error envelope and mapping for 401, 403, 422, and 5xx.
exit_criteria: Error contract documented and consumed by service layer with typed mapping.

title: Integrate remote case endpoints
description: Connect case read and write endpoints with tenant and role context.
exit_criteria: Case list, detail, create, and update run against remote contract in staging smoke.

title: Integrate chat orchestrator modes
description: Connect chat endpoint and action mode responses for suggest, confirm_then_execute, and blocked.
exit_criteria: Chat flow receives policy mode and action metadata from backend.

title: Integrate audit query endpoint
description: Connect audit query endpoint for case and request trails.
exit_criteria: Audit timeline can be queried by case and actor with consistent payloads.

title: Enforce tenant and role visibility in runtime
description: Apply tenant and role visibility enforcement across runtime navigation and entity access.
exit_criteria: Users only see allowed views and entities from bootstrap role and tenant scope.

title: Implement case create and update UX with policy mode
description: Implement case create and update flows from chat and structured case surfaces with policy mode display.
exit_criteria: Users complete create and update flow and see mode specific UI.

title: Add actionable validation feedback for 422 errors
description: Render actionable field or action level feedback for 422 validation failures.
exit_criteria: Validation failures provide clear guidance without silent errors.

title: Expose audit trail in case detail
description: Add audit trail surface in case detail with action provenance.
exit_criteria: Case detail shows actor, action, result, and timestamp from audit API.

title: Define Release 1 audit taxonomy
description: Define audit taxonomy for chat and case mutations.
exit_criteria: Taxonomy approved and mapped to AuditEventDto.

title: Correlate auditable event IDs
description: Emit auditable event IDs across case and chat actions and correlate in UI.
exit_criteria: UI and logs expose stable event IDs for mutation flows.

title: Validate permission matrix enforcement
description: Validate role and tenant allow deny masked outcomes for Release 1 actions.
exit_criteria: Matrix scenarios pass for allow, deny, and masked outcomes.

title: Add contract and backward compatibility tests
description: Add schema and backward compatibility checks for Release 1 DTOs.
exit_criteria: Contract suite passes in CI and staging smoke.

title: Add policy and permission integration coverage
description: Add unit and integration coverage for policy routing, permission checks, and error mapping.
exit_criteria: Integration tests assert suggest confirm blocked and role enforcement.

title: Add role based e2e release flows
description: Add Playwright flows for case creation from chat, case update, and audit lookup by role.
exit_criteria: E2E passes for tecnico, supervisor, and admin paths.

title: Add visual and accessibility checks
description: Add mobile and desktop visual plus accessibility checks for Release 1 surfaces.
exit_criteria: Visual and axe checks pass for loading, empty, error, and success states.

title: Run release staging gate and publish evidence
description: Run full extended regression and publish release evidence artifacts.
exit_criteria: CI and staging regression pass and request evidence is updated.
